lean.rule_text: Model lean: the side that both the desk model and DraftKings' no-vig price make the favourite (each at least 55%), priced no shorter than -200; the one game per day where the lower of the two probabilities is highest. Not a proven edge: at DraftKings' own no-vig probability the expected value is the book's margin.

backtest.note: 1u per lean at the DraftKings close, one per game day. A favourite-only rule: the record is expected to sit near the book's margin over time, whatever a short run shows.
